profiles.name: derekldavis
profiles.profile: This guy keeps finding ways to turn a decent tee ball into a full-on tax return of a scorecard. The repeatable shape here is simple: enough length to keep you interested, enough fairways to fool you, and then the rest of the round gets mugged by the irons and the putter in broad daylight. He can flash a little control off the tee, but the approach play and short-game leakage keep dragging the whole mess back into the swamp. The weird part is he’s still hanging around the top end of the board, which means the chaos is persistent, not random. That’s a dangerous kind of ugly golf.
